chunks: Creator of the heavens and the earth, how could He have a son when He has no mate? He created all things, and has knowledge of all things.
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran refute God having a son based on His creation of the heavens and earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing Tawhid al-Zat (Oneness of Essence) by negating physical procreation, distinguishing Allah from created beings who require a mate. The term 'Badi' (Originator) emphasizes His unique power to create without precedent or need, directly refuting Christian and pagan notions of divine offspring. This logical deduction reinforces that His knowledge encompasses all details, ensuring no aspect of creation is unknown to Him.
